canonical: A64=U64@H64 in CPUFP64, A32=single nearest FP32 conversion; same path all384 unique heads, no search

contract_C.C1_vs_S3_no_QDQ: same functions and same A; actual values/bytes identical on same device expected

independent_branch_policy.P1: Independent CPU PBR reuse + actual perGPU P1 qualification; never needs U receipt
